name: Fang Pelagic
description: Fang Pelagic is a swollen ocean world, larger than most of its type, where the water runs hot and acidic near the equator and merely warm toward the poles. Towering wave formations called fangs rise during tidal surges, cresting at over three hundred meters before collapsing in walls of white foam. The planet's single hurricane has raged for recorded history, covering a quarter of the surface in perpetual cyclonic fury.

The dense atmosphere presses down oppressively, and the air has a chemical bite that irritates unprotected skin within minutes. Visibility shifts constantly as banks of acid fog roll across the surface, and the ocean beneath is a murky amber color, heated from below by extensive geothermal venting. The sound is overwhelming, a ceaseless roar of wind and wave that drowns out everything else.

A derelict space station orbits Fang Pelagic in a decaying trajectory, its crew evacuated decades ago when the planet was quarantined. The quarantine was imposed after a research team discovered that the marine fauna were dying en masse from an unidentified pathogen that showed signs of engineered origin. Theories range from a bioweapon test to an alien sterilization attempt, but the station's records were corrupted during evacuation.

The quarantine remains in effect, but enforcement has lapsed, and black-market bio-harvesters have begun making runs to collect samples from the dying ecosystem. The pathogen has not been shown to affect non-native biology, but no one is certain. The derelict station will enter the atmosphere within a decade, and its reactor core presents a contamination risk that no government has yet agreed to fund addressing.
